auditSensitivityCaveat: Primary conservative acceptance preserves existing test files. The instruction allowing own new tests can also mean added cases within existing files: report that append-only sensitivity separately, only when the delivered tests actually pass. Source-audited completion excludes instruction/environment compliance and is not full-request acceptance. All dimensions retain confirmed production and added-test regressions; none replaces the registered primary metric.
optionalConfigShapeSensitivityCaveat: Source-only sensitivity accepts an additional own undefined property for the newly introduced optional configuration field. Original upstream exact-object assertions reject that shape, including in the F42 positive controls; interpreting it as a user-visible compatibility defect is stricter than some API-evolution conventions. This sensitivity still rejects independent numerical/type/added-test errors and does not establish instruction/environment compliance.
functionalComparisonCaveat: Secondary descriptive comparison on selected-check success only. It can include incorrect extra changes or instruction violations; it cannot establish full-task quality parity.

accounting.method: Known SDK estimates plus explicit missing-aggregate/unreported-request reserves, not imputed consumption. Wire/report counts do not establish billing or hidden retries.

incompleteTrialAccounting: Missing final aggregates and durations remain null. Known partial per-request SDK cost receipts are reported separately, never substituted for a complete trial total; scheduling retains the full missing-aggregate allowance. Administrative interruptions stay in assigned denominators and are not model retries or demonstrated harness failures.
limitations: 3 constructed tasks in 1 project(s), 2 dependent repeats. All three previously selected Valibot requests, two repetitions each. These are known diagnostic tasks, not fresh confirmation. Exploratory engineering began after the first ten F42 trials; final registration follows the complete F42 audit. Unblinded source review by the research agent, unknown provider revision/seeds/invoices, nonexclusive host. SDK estimates/cache receipts are observations, not complete provider billing. Do not pool campaigns or attribute resource differences to unused mechanisms. Whole private workspace archives are retained by SHA-256; public traces include original diffs, events, grades, contracts and deliveries. Recorded host workload overlaps and duration sensitivities are reported separately; unknown contention is not excluded.
